subject: Pen test evidence, scope clarification, and remediation status for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Alice Thompson <alice@acme-retail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + remediation status for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SIG/CAIQ and vendor risk intake, Acme needs the pen test report and a short remediation summary tied to open findings. Could you confirm the following for our security team?

- Which engagement was performed (3rd-party firm name) and test dates.
- Exact scope: production vs. staging, domains and endpoints tested.
- A one-page summary of high/critical findings and current remediation status.
- Evidence for remediations (Jira ticket IDs, PR links, patch version, CVE references or commit IDs).
- Any SAST/DAST/Security-scan outputs you can share (redacted if necessary).

We also need to know whether you can provide a redacted copy of the full report or only a summary. Our risk team is deadline-driven — can you get something to us by end of day Tuesday (2026-03-02)?

Thanks,
Alice Thompson
InfoSec Lead, Acme Retail
security@acme-retail.com

Attachment: n/a
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: dev_patel@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Thompson <alice@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: pen test report + remediation status for SIG/CAIQ

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. They need pen test artifacts + remediation evidence by EOD Tue 2026-03-02. Below are the deliverables they listed. Can we triage and assemble?

Deliverables requested:
- Formal pen test report (redacted allowed) + one-page summary of high/critical findings
- Scope statement (who performed the test, dates, targets, prod vs staging)
- Evidence for fixes (Jira IDs, PRs, CVE/patch references, deployment timestamps)
- SAST/DAST outputs (CSV/summary) and any mitigation traces

Can we split tasks:
- Dev: gather SAST/DAST exports and the raw findings we have (if sensitive, note what needs redaction)
- Vivek: confirm scope (prod/staging) and provide remediation ticket list + deployment confirmation
- Monica: prepare a short cover note and redaction guidance for the customer (legal/PII concerns)
- Jonas: loop in if we want to offer a short call with Acme for walkthrough

If anything blocks the EOD Tue timeline, flag here with ETA. Alice — we'll do our best to get a sanitized package over.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Solutions (Security Liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test report + remediation status for SIG/CAIQ

Marissa — putting together the artifacts. Current status:

- Pen test performed by VectorSec (3rd party) on 2025-11-18 -> 2025-11-21 against staging environment only (staging.redwood.example.com).
- I have the redacted summary PDF (redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-11.pdf) ready for customer consumption.
- Raw findings export (SAST/DAST) available: sast-scan-jan2026.csv (sensitive, remove absolute paths and personnel IDs before sending).
- High-level: VectorSec reported 1 medium (auth bypass pattern), 3 low (info leakage), and a few false positives. Most lows were configuration-related.
- Evidence links: SEC-412 (Jira) covers the auth bypass; PR #4982 includes the fix; merged on 2026-02-10; deployed in canary 2026-02-12, full prod deploy 2026-02-15.

Question: Do we send the full raw VectorSec report (it contains tester notes and contact info) or only the redacted summary + exports? Monica: please advise if legal prefers summary only.

I'll attach the CSV and the summary PDF to the internal thread folder; marking sensitive fields for redaction.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): sast-scan-jan2026.csv, redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-11.pdf
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test report + remediation status for SIG/CAIQ

Confirming scope and remediation state:

- Scope: Pen test targeted staging only; production was explicitly out of scope. Domain list in VectorSec's workpaper: staging.redwood.example.com, api-staging.redwood.example.com.
- Remediation: Auth bypass (medium) — SEC-412, PR #4982 — status: closed; deployed to prod 2026-02-15.
- Remaining: Two low-severity configuration items (SEC-421, SEC-423) — owners assigned, ETA for fixes: 2026-03-10. We have mitigation workarounds in place (WAF rule and config lock) and an ops trace log proving the rule was in effect after 2026-02-20 (mitigation-trace-20260302.log).
- Evidence: SEC-412 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-412), ENG-2567 (integration regression PR), and deployment audit entries: deploy-2026-02-12-canary, deploy-2026-02-15-prod.

I recommend sending the redacted VectorSec summary + the SAST CSV with columns that do not include test authors or internal IPs. We should not send raw tester notes or contact info. Monica: if legal agrees, I'll sign off on the sanitized package.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SRE/Platform Engineering

Attachments (internal): mitigation-trace-20260302.log

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the patience — please find attached a redacted pen test summary and supporting artifacts to satisfy your SIG/CAIQ intake. We have intentionally removed tester contact details and any internal IP/address values.

Summary of what's attached:
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-11.pdf (redacted VectorSec executive summary; includes one-page high/critical findings summary)
- sast-scan-jan2026.csv (SAST export with sensitive columns removed)
- mitigation-trace-20260302.log (ops trace showing WAF mitigation in place for two low items)

Quick status snapshot:
- Engagement: VectorSec, 2025-11-18 -> 2025-11-21, scope: staging only.
- High/Medium: 1 medium (auth bypass) — SEC-412 (PR #4982) — fixed and deployed to prod on 2026-02-15. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-412
- Lows: 2 configuration items (SEC-421, SEC-423) — owners assigned, ETA for completion: 2026-03-10. Workarounds in place and documented.

If you would like the full (unredacted) VectorSec report we need a signed NDA and an updated scope approval; let me know and I can route next steps through our legal team. If helpful, we can also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our security/engineering leads this week.

Next update: we'll notify you when SEC-421 and SEC-423 are closed (expected by 2026-03-10).

Best,
Marissa Cole
